Talent0_2Ability.name: Dawnstar Tech
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: Rail Gun's DMG <color=#F74848>+20%</color> and gains <buf ID=900060>[Diagonal Shot]</buf>. When a Rail Gun runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Dawnstar Tech
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects: Rail Gun's DMG <color=#F74848>+20%</color> and gains <buf ID=900060>[Diagonal Shot]</buf>. When a Rail Gun runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

300001.name: Sniper Warfare 1
300001.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

300702.name: The More, The Better
300702.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Rail Gun, for every additional <color=#F74848>1</color> target hit, DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

300703.name: Judgment
300703.describe: Uses the Light Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.55x</color> DMG. Targets the part with the lowest HP.

300704.name: Instant Load
300704.describe: Fully restore Rail Gun Ammo and gain <buf ID=7100105>[Hit Rate UP III]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn. Can continue the action with the remaining movement.

300705.name: Good Start
300705.SpecificEffects: When attacking with the first Ammo in the Rail Gun Magazine, DMG <color=#F74848>+20%</color>.

300706.name: Accurate Sanction
300706.describe: Uses Rail Gun to attack the same part of all targets within a <range type=1>Line (1*5 tiles) area</range> or a Diagonal (4 tiles) area and deals <color=#F74848>0.85x</color> AoE DMG. Before combat, access <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> mode.

300707.name: Ballistics Bonus
300707.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Light Rifle, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> tile the target is farther away, DMG <color=#F74848>+6%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>30%</color>.

300708.name: Saturated Strike
300708.describe: Consume <color=#F74848>3</color> rounds of Ammo. Uses Rail Gun to attack all targets within a <range type=1>3*5 tile area</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>1.25x</color> AoE DMG.

300011.name: Sniper Warfare 2
300011.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>.

300021.name: Sniper Warfare 3
300021.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

300022.name: Power Innovation 2
300022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

300031.name: Forbidden Zone 1
300031.SpecificEffects: With a Ranged Weapon, launch <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf> before the enemy attack within range, dealing <color=#F74848>0.35x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

300034.name: Forbidden Zone 2
300034.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

300035.name: Forbidden Zone 3
300035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.5</color>.

300036.name: Forbidden Zone 4
300036.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf> is launched against an enemy that has not attacked. Targets the part with the lowest HP.

300043.name: Power Innovation 3
300043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

300744.name: Railgun Specialist 2
300744.SpecificEffects: Each turn, auto-load <color=#F74848>1</color> Ammo into the non-exhausted Rail Gun magazine.
